items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: Well, you know, Doc Sushan said that King Oliver didn't want anybody to know what he was playing.

ctx.x: Did you get in, when you were in New Orleans, did you get into any of those dance halls down there? Well, I used to look in on them.

I never, I kind of went out to be strolling around, of course they were playing good jazz there in those places. They were pretty rough places, weren't they? Well, they were, they were, well, there was a pretty heavy crowd, you may say, the roughnecks that did that. But I don't recall any disturbance except when they killed Billy Phillips. And that was rough that night. That's Billy Phillips. Yeah, he ran the 101 Ranch. The competition was right across the street at the tuxedo competition. And the story was then,…
Plus the musicians all remember who played, but nobody else does down there from that period, I guess.
